posts.name: VinVAI
posts.tagline: Install Vinv once, give coding agents a verification layer
posts.description: Vinv is an IDE plugin that auto-exposes its MCPs to all coding harnesses on your system. It gives harnesses the same runtime information and context about the repo you are working on, connects runtime traces to the source code, provides context for the coding agents, and reruns the code to verify that the fix works. It uses Thompson sampling to figure out how much runtime context to give the agent. Everything runs locally. Open source, Apache 2.0.

posts.name: Riffla
posts.tagline: LinkedIn capture, enrichment, CRM sync and 300M+ search
posts.description: Riffla turns LinkedIn into your pipeline. A side panel reads any profile as you browse: capture the lead, draft a personalised outreach message from their real experience, find a verified email, and push it all to your CRM — without leaving the page. Or skip LinkedIn entirely. Describe who you're looking for in plain English and search 300M+ professionals from your dashboard. Everything lands in one table. And you're only charged when we actually verify a contact.

posts.name: Math Buddy
posts.tagline: Math Buddy: The distraction-free calculator for kids
posts.description: A fun, educational calculator for kids to learn and explore math with Math Buddy!

posts.name: KMRVID Skills
posts.tagline: 58 production skills connecting Figma AI to Claude Code
posts.description: Stop generic AI slop and broken design handoffs. KMRVID Skills provides 58 battle-tested custom skills across Figma Design Agent and Claude Code. Automate audits, tokens, Modern Tailwind CSS based frontend pipelines (React / Astro / Vanilla), and WCAG a11y. Built for production, open for learning.

posts.name: ScaleCheck - 3D Size Comparison
posts.tagline: Compare the true scale of massive objects in 3D.
posts.description: Compare animals, structures, and worlds in an interactive true-scale 3D atlas. Ever wondered how a giant whale measures up to the Eiffel Tower, or how Earth compares to a red supergiant? ScaleCheck.xyz goes beyond static 2D images. We let you zoom, rotate, and explore fully interactive 3D models to truly grasp the sheer size of massive giants and the vast cosmos.

posts.name: Imgfree
posts.tagline: AI images and video creation in one studio
posts.description: Imgfree brings image and video generation tools into one place so creators can turn prompts into visual content faster.

posts.name: BetaFeedback
posts.tagline: find testers, ship cleaner builds
posts.description: BetaFeedback helps you find people open to testing, swap builds with other creators, and turn tester feedback into structured bug reports automatically. Download for iOS and Android.

posts.name: Griffy – India’s Construction Network
posts.tagline: Fom Quick Fix to Dream Home — Build Better, Together.
posts.description: India's one-stop construction platform. Find verified contractors, hire skilled labour, book service experts, source building materials at best prices and discover land — all in one place. Now live across J&K, Punjab, Chandigarh and Himachal.

posts.name: Ranktop
posts.tagline: Fair Website Ranking & Product Leaderboard
posts.description: Rank your website or SaaS product on a live leaderboard with fair bidding. Every new top bid is limited to a $10 increase, so every founder can compete.

posts.name: Contenza
posts.tagline: AI content that ships to Shopify, your app, or any API
posts.description: Describe what you need and Contenza drafts it into your own content models — not a text blob. Review it, localize it, then publish to your Shopify blog, your app via SDK, or any API. Free tier: 20,000 entries, 2M API calls, 500k AI tokens.

posts.name: CalendarOCR
posts.tagline: Turn pictures into calendar events in seconds.
posts.description: CalendarOCR turns screenshots, posters, syllabi, and event images directly into calendar events using AI. Instead of manually copying dates, times, locations, and details, users can scan an image and add the event in seconds. It’s designed to be fast, lightweight, and practical for the schedules people already encounter every day.

posts.name: Paperly
posts.tagline: Scan, edit, OCR, and manage PDFs privately
posts.description: Paperly makes everyday document work a lot less frustrating. Scan your IDs and documents, edit existing PDFs, add or remove pages, crop, merge, split, OCR, annotate, sign, organize, and export — all in one place. Your files stay on your device, so you can get things done without sending your documents to the cloud or being tracked.

posts.name: GoMobSec
posts.tagline: AI-powered mobile app security testing
posts.description: We built GoMobSec to make mobile app security testing easier and faster. It helps developers and security teams test Android apps, find potential vulnerabilities, and understand what needs to be fixed. Instead of switching between multiple tools, GoMobSec brings the testing process together in one place and uses AI to help make sense of the results.

posts.name: CSV Hospital
posts.tagline: Clean, repair, and format broken CSV files in seconds
posts.description: CSV Hospital is the digital ER for messy spreadsheets. Admit a CSV in your browser: remove empty rows, trim whitespace, standardize headers, then download a clean file. Privacy-first — your data stays on your device.

posts.name: Where is Paul?
posts.tagline: Open-source spatial travel blog and living memory map.
posts.description: Most life-story and travel tools are built for a single screen size or format. Where is Paul? is designed to work the same way on mobile, desktop, and in augmented or virtual reality. It presents a personal history as a spatial record (globe + timeline) and can turn experiences into comic-style sequences. The project is fully open source so others can clone it and build their own version.

posts.name: temsor API — one key, every endpoint
posts.tagline: One key for IBAN, VIES, dated EU VAT rates and GLEIF lookups
posts.description: One key: Turkish severance and VAT tables, identifier checksums, sanctions screening, address and e-invoice parsing, dated FX and fuel archives. Metered per call, cache hits free.

posts.name: Resizeify
posts.tagline: Resize, compress, and reduce image size directly in browser
posts.description: Resizeify is a fast, free, and private online image resizer and reducer. Easily scale dimensions by pixels or centimeters, or compress images down to an exact file size in KB (like under 50KB or 100KB). Everything runs 100% client-side inside your browser—your images are never uploaded or stored on any server.

posts.name: Cue
posts.tagline: Every AI ships the same hero. Cue ships the one that lands.
posts.description: Every AI tool ships the same-looking hero. Cue is the taste layer that fixes that — hand-picked prompts for Bolt, v0, Cursor, and Framer that land you at the version worth shipping to a client. 50+ prompts curated from Awwwards-tier sites. Not generated to fill the grid — each one replaced when a better reference exists. New drops every week, forever. Founding lifetime: $99 for the first 50 members. After that, $249. One-time. No subscription.

posts.name: Rasterbator.io
posts.tagline: Turn image into a giant poster/wall art with a home printer
posts.description: Turn any image into a wall-sized poster you can print at home. Choose the finished size and paper, customize the style, preview the tiled layout, then download a print-ready PDF with margins, overlap, cut guides, and page labels. Files stay in your browser.

posts.name: AgentDeck
posts.tagline: Every Claude and Codex account. One secure desktop app.
posts.description: Keep your AI work moving when a 5-hour limit hits. AgentDeck puts every Claude and ChatGPT/Codex account in one desktop workspace, shows limits and usage at a glance, and lets you continue sessions across accounts or between Claude and Codex without rebuilding context. Work securely from your phone or tablet, use local or approved models, and optionally mask personal or sensitive data and check untrusted content for prompt injection before sending.

posts.name: Carousel to Reel
posts.tagline: Turn finished carousel images into readable Facebook Reels
posts.description: Turn 2–20 images or photos into a readable, ready-to-post Facebook Reel in your browser. Set the pace, add optional audio, and export with no cropping.

posts.name: Shots Fired
posts.tagline: A range tracker that never builds a registry of your guns
posts.description: Most shooting apps sync a timestamped record of what you own and how often you shoot it to someone else's server. Shots Fired does not. It is a full range tracker for iPhone that stores everything locally. No account, no cloud, no registry.

posts.name: Just Checking In
posts.tagline: Know how the people you love are really doing
posts.description: A private daily emotional check-in app for families, friends, and trusted circles. Share how you feel and know when it may be time to reach out.

posts.name: Sara — AI School Tutor
posts.tagline: Your AI tutor for better learning
posts.description: Sara is an AI-powered virtual teacher that follows the school curriculum and adapts to every student. She delivers structured lessons with an interactive board, voice, examples, and exercises. When students make mistakes, Sara explains why instead of giving the answer. She tracks progress, identifies gaps, and automatically plans what to review next. A personalized AI tutor, available anytime.
